facts.fact: Ila greets Rohan at the Fair by telling him he is two hours late and a belt-hole thinner (measured exactly, as a surveyor would). Revises F308's 'eight days late'.

At the Fair Pritam orders the forty to hold the herald and claims Neshar owes him eleven hundred measures of winter grain; Rohan answers that his bell mark is on every sack in Ranu. The officer's spear drops and he gives no order after Tej's sword belt lies on the grass.
Meera uses the rope signal of one long pull (come, per F128) to call Rohan away from Ila at the Fair; he leaves his sister mid-sentence and follows.
